worldcombat.skill.seedbomb.summary: Lobs a pod of hard-shelled seeds overhead so they fall onto the target from above: every non-ally in a small ring at the landing point takes one volley of hard seeds. Heavy is fewer but harder and narrower; Loose is many but lighter and wider.
worldcombat.skill.seedbomb.use.0: Drop seeds onto a target over a low piece of terrain
worldcombat.skill.seedbomb.use.1: Cover a small landing area and force the foe to move
worldcombat.skill.seedbomb.use.3: Land a volley before a charging foe closes in
worldcombat.skill.seedbomb.description.0: One pod of hard seeds deals about %1$s damage; the target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.seedbomb.description.1: The pod breaks open overhead, covering a ring of about %1$s blocks, each seed about %2$s blocks across.
worldcombat.skill.seedbomb.description.2: It throws up to %1$s blocks, at an arc speed of about %2$s blocks per tick.
worldcombat.skill.seedbomb.option.on: Heavy: volley about x1.18 and landing about x0.85, wind-up +3 and cooldown +5 ticks - heavier, narrower.
worldcombat.skill.seedbomb.option.off: Loose: landing about x1.15 and a faster cast, at a volley of about x0.9 - lighter, wider.
worldcombat.skill.seedbomb.timing: Throw up to %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.seedbomb.growth.0: At level %1$s the volley rises to %2$s power and the landing ring to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.seedbomb.preference.he: On: volley about x1.18, but landing about x0.85, wind-up +3 and cooldown +5 ticks - heavier, narrower, for dropping a single spot. Off (Loose): landing about x1.15 and a faster cast, at a volley of about x0.9 - lighter, wider, for covering an area and forcing movement.
worldcombat.skill.seedbomb.preference.ai: The companion only lobs a pod at a threat within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher opens with a volley from afar.
On: a grounded target scores one tier higher, since the rain falls from above and a standing target takes it fully; off: airborne targets are ranked the same.
